project_meta.name: NEV_KGQA_Pipeline
project_meta.description: Knowledge Graph QA for New Energy Vehicles

environment.training_hardware: NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU (Used for model fine-tuning)
environment.inference_hardware: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11850H CPU (Used for 150k knowledge extraction & QA deployment)

BERT_BiLSTM_CRF.early_stopping: Triggered around epoch 10-15 to prevent overfitting
BERT_BiLSTM_CRF.description: Encoder for multi-source NEV diagnostic text. Trained on GPU.

TextCNN_Intent.description: High-concurrency intent parsing. Deployed and validated on CPU.

alignment_strategy.note: Weights are optimized for Chinese NEV terminology morphological (Dice) and semantic (BERT) fusion.
